---
title: "Annotation"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: hide
#| warning: false
#| error: false
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)
cohort_id <- NULL
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| error: false
#| message: false
# Get all available annotations for downstream analyses
available_annotation_files <- dir(
  "available_annotations",
  pattern = "\\.txt$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)
available_annotations <- unlist(sapply(available_annotation_files, scan, character()))
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
# Determine which annotations were performed
cell_cycle_annotated <- dir.exists("annotation_cc")
db_annotated <- dir.exists("annotation_db")
custom_annotated <- dir.exists("annotation_custom")
clusters_annotated <- dir.exists("annotation_clusters")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| error: false
#| message: false
#| eval: !expr cell_cycle_annotated
# Cell cycle annotation
cc_umap_file <- dir(
  "annotation_cc",
  pattern = "^.*\\.umap\\.cell_cycle\\.png$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)[1]

# Get cohort ID
cohort_id <- gsub("^annotation_cc\\/(.*)\\.umap\\.cell_cycle\\.png$", "\\1", cc_umap_file)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| error: false
#| message: false
#| eval: !expr db_annotated
# Database annotation
db_umap_file <- dir(
  "annotation_db",
  pattern = "^.*\\.umap\\..*\\.png$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)[1]

# Get cohort ID
if (is.null(cohort_id)) {
  cohort_id <- gsub("^annotation_db\\/(.*)\\.umap\\..*\\.png$", "\\1", db_umap_file)
}

cell_type_props <- paste0("annotation_db/", cohort_id, ".cell_type_proportions.singleR_annotation.png")

cell_type_prop_table_hpca_main <- paste0("annotation_db/", cohort_id, ".cell_type_proportions.singleR_annotation.hpca_main.csv")
cell_type_prop_table_hpca_fine <- paste0("annotation_db/", cohort_id, ".cell_type_proportions.singleR_annotation.hpca_fine.csv")
cell_type_prop_table_singler <- paste0("annotation_db/", cohort_id, ".cell_type_proportions.singleR_annotation.csv")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| error: false
#| message: false
#| eval: !expr custom_annotated
# Custom annotation
custom_umap <- dir(
  "annotation_custom",
  pattern = "^.*\\.umap\\.custom_annotation\\.png$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)[1]

# Get cohort ID
if (is.null(cohort_id)) {
  cohort_id <- gsub("^annotation_custom\\/(.*)\\.umap\\.custom_annotation\\.png$", "\\1", custom_umap)
}

custom_heatmap <- paste0("annotation_custom/", cohort_id, ".heatmap.custom_annotations_per_cluster.png")

custom_cell_type_props <- paste0("annotation_custom/", cohort_id, ".cell_type_proportions.custom_annotation.png")
custom_cell_type_props_table_file <- paste0("annotation_custom/", cohort_id, ".cell_type_proportions.custom_annotation.csv")
custom_cell_type_props_table <- read_csv(custom_cell_type_props_table_file)

custom_cell_type_feature_plots <- dir(
  "annotation_custom",
  pattern = "^.*\\.custom_annotation_scores\\..*\\.png$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)
names(custom_cell_type_feature_plots) <- sapply(custom_cell_type_feature_plots, function(f) {
  gsub("^annotation_custom\\/.*\\.custom_annotation_scores\\.(.*)\\.png$", "\\1", f)
})
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| error: false
#| message: false
#| eval: !expr clusters_annotated
# Cluster annotation
cluster_umap_file <- dir(
  "annotation_clusters",
  pattern = "^.*\\.umap\\.cluster_cell_type_assignments\\.png$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)[1]

# Get cohort ID
if (is.null(cohort_id)) {
  cohort_id <- gsub("^annotation_cluster\\/(.*)\\.umap\\.cluster_cell_type_assignments\\.png$", "\\1", cluster_umap_file)
}
```

#### Dataset name: `{r} cohort_id`

### All annotation fields available for downstream analyses

```{r}
  cat("- ")
  cat(ann)
  cat("\n")
}
```

```{r}
cat("#### Custom cell type feature plots\n\n")
for (cell_type in names(custom_cell_type_feature_plots)) {
  p <- custom_cell_type_feature_plots[[cell_type]]
  cat(paste0("##### ", cell_type, "\n\n"))
  cat(paste0('<img src="', p, '" alt="feature plot: ', cell_type, ' - ', cohort_id, '" width="100%">\n\n'))
}
```
